name: OmaOneDrive
author: Salem Sayed
description: OneDrive service status, cloud usage, and recent files in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Control the installed OneDrive CLI, check cloud sync status, and open recent local files.

schema.label: Local refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Reads the local service, journal, and cached cloud status. It does not contact Microsoft.

schema.label: Recent files
schema.description: Maximum number of recently modified local OneDrive files shown in the panel.
